facts.text: The resort dates from 1930 and sits on the Ottawa River; it was built with 10,000 giant red cedar logs, all cut and set by hand.
facts.excerpt: this 1930 resort on the Ottawa River was built with 10,000 giant red cedar logs, all cut and set by hand.

facts.text: The resort was inspired by the châteaux of the Swiss Alps.
facts.excerpt: Inspired by the châteaux of the Swiss Alps

facts.text: A six-sided fireplace with a central chimney is the focal point of the three-story atrium.
facts.excerpt: A six-sided fireplace with a central chimney is the focal point of the three-story atrium.

facts.text: The resort is midway between Montreal and Ottawa.
Rooms mix rich woodwork with custom fabrics and rustic accessories, and have windows that open to let in fresh air.
facts.excerpt: Rooms mix rich woodwork with custom fabrics and rustic accessories and have windows that open to let in the fresh air

facts.text: Fairmont River View rooms are located mostly on the first and second floors and have large windows offering views of the Ottawa River.
facts.excerpt: Fairmont River View Rooms are located mostly on the first and second floors and have large windows offering views of the Ottawa River.

facts.text: The Deluxe Jacuzzi Suite has a two-person jacuzzi.
The restaurant Aux Chantignoles uses regional ingredients.
The golf course was designed by Stanley Thompson.
facts.excerpt: Designed by Stanley Thompson, our golf course is amongst the best public courses in Quebec.

facts.text: The aquatic center offers swimming and lounging, and there is a health club with indoor tennis and squash.
facts.excerpt: Discover our aquatic center: swim, lounge, or visit the health club - start your day right and enjoy indoor tennis or squash for extra fun.

facts.text: The hotel has a Fairmont Spa offering a variety of spa treatments.
facts.excerpt: Yes, the hotel has a Fairmont Spa with a variety of unique spa treatments available.
Yes, we welcome furry friends at our pet-friendly hotel.

facts.text: Outdoor self-parking for guests is included in the Resort Experience Fee.
facts.excerpt: Outdoor self-parking for guests is included in the Resort Experience Fee.

facts.text: Charging stations are available for Teslas and other electric vehicles.
facts.excerpt: Charging stations are available for Teslas and other electric vehicles.

facts.text: The resort offers more than 40 activities and experiences on-site.
facts.excerpt: is a welcoming resort destination with more than 40 unique activities and experiences available on-site.
